scope: PPLX streamed WebGPU double-buffer correctness; no hardware throughput claim
default: Enabled for streamed WebGPU with prefetch; resident loading remains separate
scheduling: Submit layer i compute, enqueue layer i+1 weights into the other bank, await both, then swap. Reuse a bank only after its previous compute completes.
bank_storage: Raw BF16 weights; active FP16/INT8/Q4 conversions and activations are additional allocations

runtime_checks: uploads between compute submission and completion
delayed reads, read failures, and compute failures before/after submission
in-flight disposal prevention, read/compute draining, and retries
timing summaries do not count overlapping uploads twice

weight_buffers.scope: raw BF16 weight banks; excludes active converted/quantized weights and activations
weight_buffers.overlap: uploads enqueued after compute submission and before its completion wait; hardware overlap is implementation-dependent

limitations: SwiftShader correctness checks; physical DMA/compute overlap and speedup require a hardware GPU measurement
WebGPU uses one queue; concurrent JavaScript submission does not guarantee parallel GPU copy/compute execution
Configured FP16/INT8/Q4 paths compile but were not GPU-tested here because the adapter lacks shader-f16
Full-checkpoint parity covers one saved fixture, not a model-quality evaluation

provenance.runtime_difference: Timing accounting only; final accounting validated by the runtime checks

reproduce.worker: Repeat the streaming page with worker=1
